title: Verify: Effects schema, effect creation and transition order unit tests
summary: Prove effects parse, build and transition in order with fakes.
description: Fake RenderContext and schema parsing tests.
acceptance_criteria: Dust and ambient light effect creation, the empty-effects default and the invalid effect type error are asserted
Transition order fade out, swap, fade in is asserted

steps.action: With a fake RenderContext, assert a dust def with count 5 calls addParticles(key,5) and setDepth(400), an ambientLight def with color 0x112233 and alpha 0.3 calls addOverlay(0x112233,0.3), and undefined defs return [].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/effects.test.ts

steps.action: Use a fake ctx whose fade invokes its callback synchronously and records calls; assert the recorded sequence is ['fade:out','swap','fade:in'].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/transition.test.ts

steps.action: Add tests that parseWorldContent('scene', fixture without effects) is ok with data.effects equal to [] and that effects [{id:'d',type:'bogus'}] returns ok false with an error path starting 'effects.0'.
